description: This file defines a data class `GatewayEndpoint` with properties related to network gateway configurations, including optional parameters for TLS and port settings. It also includes a companion object with a factory method `manual` for creating instances with specified host and port.

classes.name: GatewayEndpoint
classes.description: A data class representing gateway network endpoint configuration, including identifiers, host information, port numbers, and security settings.

methods.name: manual
methods.description: A factory method to create a GatewayEndpoint instance with specified host and port, defaulting TLS to disabled.
